label: bt__hct
description: Hematocrit - measures the percentage of blood volume occupied by red blood cells (%). Indicates the proportion of blood composed of RBCs.

label: bt__mchc
description: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration - measures the average concentration of hemoglobin within red blood cells (g/dL). Calculated from hemoglobin divided by hematocrit.

label: frailty_body_comp_arm_left_lean_mass
description: Lean muscle mass (fat-free mass excluding bone) in the left arm, typically measured in kilograms using bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) or DEXA. Component of total body lean mass assessment for frailty evaluation.

label: frailty_body_comp_arm_right_lean_mass
description: Lean muscle mass (fat-free mass excluding bone) in the right arm, typically measured in kilograms using bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) or DEXA. Component of total body lean mass assessment for frailty evaluation.

label: frailty_body_comp_leg_left_lean_mass
description: Lean muscle mass (fat-free mass excluding bone) in the left leg, typically measured in kilograms using bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) or DEXA. Used to assess muscular symmetry and overall lower body muscle mass in frailty evaluation.

label: frailty_body_comp_leg_right_lean_mass
description: Lean muscle mass (fat-free mass excluding bone) in the right leg, typically measured in kilograms using bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) or DEXA. A key body composition marker used to assess muscle loss and sarcopenia, which are core features of the frailty syndrome.

label: hand_grip_left
description: Maximal left hand grip strength measured in kilograms using a hand dynamometer, indicating muscular strength and overall physical function

label: hand_grip_right
description: Maximal right hand grip strength measured in kilograms using a hand dynamometer, indicating muscular strength and overall physical function

label: happiness_level
description: Subjective rating of overall happiness and positive emotional state, a core measure of subjective well-being

label: health_satisfaction
description: Subjective rating of satisfaction with overall health status and health condition

label: hours_computer_not_work
description: Hours spent using computers for non-work purposes per week, measuring sedentary recreational screen time

label: hours_driving
description: Total hours spent driving per day/week, a lifestyle physical activity exposure measure

label: hours_outdoors_summer
description: Total hours spent outdoors during summer season, a lifestyle environmental exposure measure

label: hours_outdoors_winter
description: Hours spent outdoors during winter months, measuring seasonal sun exposure and outdoor activity

label: hours_watching_tv
description: Hours spent watching television per week, measuring sedentary screen-based leisure time

label: moderate_activity_days
description: Number of days per week on which the participant engages in moderate-intensity physical activity

label: moderate_activity_minutes
description: Total minutes per week spent in moderate-intensity physical activity, reflecting cardiovascular exercise exposure

label: sleep_hours
description: Average hours of sleep per 24-hour period, measuring sleep duration as a key health and lifestyle biomarker

label: vigorous_activity_minutes
description: Total minutes per week of vigorous-intensity physical activity, a cardiovascular fitness and lifestyle measure

label: walking_days_per_week
description: Number of days per week on which the participant engages in at least 10 minutes of walking activity

label: work_days_per_week
description: Number of days per week spent working, measuring occupational time commitment

label: work_hours_per_day
description: Total hours worked per week as a measure of occupational time commitment and work-related lifestyle factor

label: bt__hdl_cholesterol
description: HDL cholesterol blood concentration ('good' cholesterol) in mg/dL; protective factor for cardiovascular health

label: bt__non_hdl_cholesterol
description: Non-HDL cholesterol blood concentration; measures total 'bad' cholesterol (LDL, VLDL, IDL) in mg/dL; indicator of cardiovascular risk

label: bt__total_cholesterol
description: Total cholesterol blood concentration; sum of all cholesterol types (HDL, LDL, VLDL) in mg/dL; key cardiovascular health marker

label: bt__triglycerides
description: Triglyceride blood concentration; measures fatty acids in blood (mg/dL), a key lipid panel component indicating metabolic health

label: ApoA1
description: Apolipoprotein A1 concentration (g/L or mmol/L), the major protein component of HDL cholesterol. Associated with cardiovascular health and lipid metabolism.

label: ApoB
description: Apolipoprotein B concentration (g/L or mmol/L), the primary apolipoprotein in VLDL, LDL, and IDL particles. Key marker of cardiovascular disease risk.

label: Cholines
description: Serum/plasma choline concentration (µmol/L), an essential nutrient important for brain development, liver function, and muscle metabolism.

label: Clinical_LDL_C
description: Clinical LDL cholesterol concentration (mmol/L or mg/dL), calculated or measured low-density lipoprotein cholesterol. Primary cardiovascular risk marker.

label: Creatinine
description: Serum creatinine concentration (µmol/L or mg/dL), a waste product of muscle metabolism. Primary marker of kidney function and glomerular filtration rate.

label: GlycA
description: Glycoprotein acetyls; a biomarker of low-grade chronic inflammation measured as a continuous concentration level

label: HDL_C
description: HDL cholesterol concentration; the 'good cholesterol' that helps remove other cholesterol types from blood

label: HDL_CE
description: HDL cholesterol ester content; the esterified cholesterol component within HDL particles

label: HDL_FC
description: HDL free cholesterol content; the unesterified cholesterol component within HDL particles

label: HDL_L
description: HDL total lipid content; the aggregate lipid mass within HDL particles

label: HDL_P
description: HDL particle number/concentration; the count or concentration of HDL particles in blood

label: HDL_PL
description: HDL phospholipid content; the phospholipid component within HDL particles

label: HDL_size
description: HDL particle size; the average diameter or size classification of HDL particles in nanometers

label: His
description: Histidine; a free amino acid concentration in blood plasma, likely a component of amino acid profiling

label: IDL_C
description: IDL cholesterol concentration; cholesterol content within intermediate-density lipoprotein particles

label: IDL_CE
description: IDL cholesterol ester content; the esterified cholesterol component within IDL particles

label: IDL_FC
description: IDL free cholesterol content; the unesterified cholesterol component within IDL particles

label: IDL_L
description: IDL total lipid content; the aggregate lipid mass within IDL particles

label: IDL_PL
description: IDL (Intermediate-Density Lipoprotein) Phospholipid content - measures the phospholipid component within intermediate-density lipoprotein particles

label: IDL_TG
description: IDL (Intermediate-Density Lipoprotein) Triglyceride content - measures the triglyceride component within intermediate-density lipoprotein particles

label: LA
description: Linoleic Acid - a polyunsaturated fatty acid measured in blood

label: LDL_C
description: LDL Cholesterol - total cholesterol content in low-density lipoprotein particles

label: LDL_CE
description: LDL Cholesteryl Ester - cholesteryl ester (esterified cholesterol) content within LDL particles

label: LDL_FC
description: LDL Free Cholesterol - unesterified (free) cholesterol content within LDL particles

label: LDL_L
description: LDL Lipids - total lipid content within LDL particles

label: LDL_PL
description: LDL Phospholipid - phospholipid content within LDL particles

label: LDL_TG
description: LDL Triglyceride - triglyceride content within LDL particles

label: L_HDL_C
description: Large HDL Cholesterol - cholesterol content in large high-density lipoprotein particles (protective 'good' cholesterol subclass)

label: L_HDL_CE
description: Large HDL Cholesteryl Ester - cholesteryl ester content in large HDL particles

label: L_HDL_FC
description: Large HDL Free Cholesterol - free (unesterified) cholesterol content in large HDL particles

label: L_HDL_L
description: Large HDL particle size - measures the concentration or size distribution of large high-density lipoprotein particles, which are considered protective against cardiovascular disease

label: L_HDL_P
description: HDL particle number - measures the total number of high-density lipoprotein particles, a key cardiovascular risk marker

label: L_HDL_PL
description: HDL phospholipid content - measures the concentration of phospholipids within HDL particles, reflecting lipoprotein composition

label: L_LDL_C
description: Large LDL cholesterol - measures the concentration of cholesterol in large low-density lipoprotein particles, associated with less atherogenic risk than small dense LDL

label: L_LDL_CE
description: Large LDL cholesterol ester - measures the concentration of cholesteryl ester, the storage form of cholesterol, within large LDL particles

label: L_LDL_FC
description: Large LDL free cholesterol - measures the concentration of unesterified cholesterol within large LDL particles

label: L_LDL_L
description: Large LDL particle size or concentration - measures the concentration or size characteristics of large low-density lipoprotein particles

label: L_LDL_PL
description: LDL phospholipid content - measures the concentration of phospholipids within LDL particles, reflecting lipoprotein composition

label: L_LDL_TG
description: LDL triglyceride content - measures the concentration of triglycerides within LDL particles, a component of lipoprotein lipid composition

label: L_VLDL_C
description: VLDL cholesterol - measures the concentration of cholesterol within very low-density lipoprotein particles, which transport triglycerides and cholesterol

label: L_VLDL_CE
description: VLDL cholesterol ester - measures the concentration of cholesteryl ester, the storage form of cholesterol, within VLDL particles

label: L_VLDL_FC
description: VLDL free cholesterol - measures the concentration of unesterified cholesterol within very low-density lipoprotein particles

label: L_VLDL_L
description: Large VLDL particle size or concentration - measures the concentration or size characteristics of very low-density lipoprotein particles

label: L_VLDL_P
description: Very Low-Density Lipoprotein particle concentration - measures the number of VLDL particles in blood, a lipoprotein class that carries triglycerides and cholesterol

label: L_VLDL_PL
description: Very Low-Density Lipoprotein phospholipid content - measures the phospholipid concentration within VLDL particles

label: L_VLDL_TG
description: Very Low-Density Lipoprotein triglyceride content - measures the triglyceride concentration within VLDL particles

label: MUFA
description: Monounsaturated Fatty Acid biomarker - measures plasma phospholipid or blood levels of monounsaturated fatty acids

label: M_HDL_C
description: Medium High-Density Lipoprotein cholesterol content - measures the cholesterol concentration within medium-sized HDL particles

label: M_HDL_CE
description: Medium High-Density Lipoprotein cholesteryl ester content - measures the cholesteryl ester concentration within medium HDL particles

label: M_HDL_FC
description: Medium High-Density Lipoprotein free cholesterol content - measures the free (non-esterified) cholesterol concentration within medium HDL particles

label: M_HDL_L
description: Medium High-Density Lipoprotein total lipid content - measures the total lipid concentration within medium-sized HDL particles

label: M_HDL_P
description: Medium High-Density Lipoprotein particle concentration - measures the number of medium-sized HDL particles in blood

label: M_HDL_PL
description: Medium High-Density Lipoprotein phospholipid content - measures the phospholipid concentration within medium HDL particles

label: M_LDL_C
description: Medium Low-Density Lipoprotein cholesterol content - measures the cholesterol concentration within medium-sized LDL particles

label: M_LDL_CE
description: Medium Low-Density Lipoprotein cholesteryl ester content - measures the cholesteryl ester concentration within medium LDL particles

label: M_LDL_FC
description: Free cholesterol content in medium-density LDL particles; a lipoprotein subfraction component measured as a proportion or concentration

label: M_LDL_L
description: Lipid content in medium-density LDL particles; represents the proportion of lipids in this lipoprotein subfraction

label: M_LDL_PL
description: Phospholipid content in medium-density LDL particles; proportion of phospholipids in LDL subfraction

label: M_LDL_TG
description: Triglyceride content in medium-density LDL particles; measures triglyceride proportion within LDL subfraction

label: M_VLDL_C
description: Total cholesterol content in medium-density VLDL particles; a biomarker for cardiovascular and metabolic risk

label: M_VLDL_CE
description: Cholesterol ester content in medium-density VLDL particles; esterified cholesterol proportion in VLDL

label: M_VLDL_FC
description: Free cholesterol content in medium-density VLDL particles; mediating biomarker in air pollution-dementia relationship

label: M_VLDL_L
description: Lipid content in medium-density VLDL particles; total lipid proportion in VLDL subfraction

label: M_VLDL_PL
description: Phospholipid content in medium-density VLDL particles; proportion of phospholipids in VLDL subfraction

label: M_VLDL_TG
description: Triglyceride content in medium-density VLDL particles; triglyceride proportion in VLDL subfraction

label: Omega_6
description: Omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acid biomarker; PUFA concentration related to metabolic and inflammatory status

label: PUFA
description: Total polyunsaturated fatty acid biomarker; combined concentration of omega-3 and omega-6 PUFA

label: Phe
description: Phenylalanine - an amino acid measured in blood/plasma, used as a biomarker for metabolic disorders and phenylketonuria (PKU)

label: Phosphatidylc
description: Phosphatidylcholine - a major phospholipid component of cell membranes and lipoproteins, measured as a lipid biomarker in blood

label: Phosphoglyc
description: Phosphoglycerides/Phospholipids - structural lipid components measured in serum as part of lipid profiling and metabolic assessment

label: Remnant_C
description: Remnant Cholesterol - cholesterol carried by remnant lipoproteins (VLDL, IDL remnants), a cardiovascular risk biomarker

label: S_HDL_C
description: Small HDL Cholesterol - cholesterol content in small high-density lipoprotein particles, a protective lipoprotein subfraction biomarker

label: S_HDL_CE
description: Small HDL Cholesteryl Ester - cholesteryl ester content in small HDL particles, a lipid composition biomarker

label: S_HDL_FC
description: Small HDL Free Cholesterol - free cholesterol content in small HDL particles, a lipoprotein composition biomarker

label: S_HDL_L
description: Small HDL Lipids - total lipid content in small HDL particles, reflecting lipoprotein particle composition

label: S_HDL_P
description: Small HDL Particles - number or concentration of small HDL particles, a lipoprotein particle count biomarker

label: S_HDL_TG
description: Small HDL Triglycerides - triglyceride content in small HDL particles, reflecting lipoprotein lipid composition

label: S_LDL_C
description: Small LDL Cholesterol - cholesterol content in small dense LDL particles, a cardiovascular risk biomarker for atherosclerotic disease

label: S_LDL_CE
description: Small LDL Cholesteryl Ester - cholesteryl ester content in small LDL particles, a lipid composition biomarker

label: S_LDL_FC
description: Free cholesterol concentration in small LDL particles, measured as a proportion of total LDL composition

label: S_LDL_L
description: Lipid content in small LDL particles, representing the proportion of lipids in small LDL subfractions

label: S_LDL_PL
description: Phospholipid content in small LDL particles, representing the proportion of phospholipids in small LDL subfractions

label: S_LDL_TG
description: Triglyceride content in small LDL particles, measuring the proportion of triglycerides in small LDL subfractions

label: S_VLDL_C
description: Cholesterol concentration in small VLDL particles, measuring the cholesterol content of small VLDL subfractions

label: S_VLDL_CE
description: Cholesterol ester content in small VLDL particles, representing the proportion of cholesterol esters in small VLDL

label: S_VLDL_FC
description: Free cholesterol concentration in small VLDL particles, measuring unesterified cholesterol in small VLDL subfractions

label: S_VLDL_L
description: Lipid content in small VLDL particles, representing the proportion of total lipids in small VLDL subfractions

label: S_VLDL_P
description: Particle concentration of small VLDL, measuring the number of small VLDL particles in circulation

label: S_VLDL_PL
description: Phospholipid content in small VLDL particles, representing the proportion of phospholipids in small VLDL subfractions

label: S_VLDL_TG
description: Triglyceride content in small VLDL particles, measuring the proportion of triglycerides in small VLDL subfractions

label: Sphingomyelins
description: Concentration of sphingomyelins, a class of sphingolipids involved in cell membrane structure and signaling

label: Total_C
description: Total cholesterol concentration in serum, measuring the sum of all cholesterol-containing lipoproteins

label: Total_CE
description: Total cholesterol esters - the concentration of cholesterol in ester form circulating in blood lipoproteins, measured in mmol/L or similar continuous unit

label: Total_FA
description: Total fatty acids - the aggregate concentration of free and esterified fatty acids in serum, measured in continuous units

label: Total_FC
description: Total free cholesterol - the concentration of unesterified cholesterol in blood, measured in mmol/L or similar units

label: Total_L
description: Total lipids - the aggregate concentration of all lipid species in serum including cholesterol, triglycerides, and phospholipids, measured in g/L or mmol/L

label: Total_P
description: Total phospholipids - the concentration of phospholipid molecules in serum, measured in mmol/L or similar units

label: Total_PL
description: Total phospholipids in lipoproteins - the concentration of phospholipid components across all lipoprotein particles in circulation

label: Total_TG
description: Total triglycerides - the concentration of triglyceride molecules in serum, measured in mmol/L, reflecting lipid metabolism and cardiovascular risk

label: VLDL_C
description: VLDL cholesterol - the concentration of total cholesterol content in very-low-density lipoprotein particles, measured in mmol/L

label: VLDL_CE
description: VLDL cholesterol esters - the concentration of esterified cholesterol within VLDL particles, measured in mmol/L

label: VLDL_FC
description: VLDL free cholesterol - the concentration of unesterified cholesterol in VLDL particles, measured in mmol/L

label: VLDL_L
description: VLDL lipids - the aggregate concentration of all lipids within VLDL particles, measured in mmol/L or g/L

label: VLDL_PL
description: VLDL phospholipids - the concentration of phospholipid components within VLDL particles, measured in mmol/L

label: VLDL_TG
description: VLDL triglycerides - the concentration of triglyceride content within VLDL particles, measured in mmol/L, reflecting triglyceride-rich lipoprotein burden

label: VLDL_size
description: Particle size of very-low-density lipoprotein (VLDL) measured in nanometers. VLDL is a lipoprotein produced by the liver that carries triglycerides and cholesterol in the bloodstream. Larger VLDL particles are generally considered less atherogenic than smaller, denser particles.

label: XL_HDL_C
description: Cholesterol content in extra-large high-density lipoprotein (XL-HDL) particles, measured in mmol/L or similar concentration units. HDL cholesterol is the 'good' cholesterol that helps remove other forms of cholesterol from the bloodstream and artery walls.

label: XL_HDL_CE
description: Cholesteryl ester (CE) content in extra-large high-density lipoprotein particles, measured in concentration units. Cholesteryl esters are the esterified form of cholesterol found within lipoprotein cores.

label: XL_HDL_FC
description: Free cholesterol (FC) content in extra-large high-density lipoprotein particles. Free cholesterol is the non-esterified form of cholesterol located on the lipoprotein surface and plays a protective role in cardiometabolic health.

label: XL_HDL_L
description: Lipid content (total lipids) in extra-large high-density lipoprotein particles, measured in concentration units.

label: XL_HDL_P
description: Particle concentration/count of extra-large high-density lipoprotein particles, typically measured in particles per liter (µmol/L or similar units).

label: XL_HDL_PL
description: Phospholipid content in extra-large high-density lipoprotein particles, measured in concentration units. Phospholipids are a major structural component of lipoprotein particles.

label: XL_VLDL_C
description: Cholesterol content in extra-large very-low-density lipoprotein particles, measured in concentration units. VLDL carries triglycerides and cholesterol from the liver to peripheral tissues.

label: XL_VLDL_CE
description: Cholesteryl ester content in extra-large VLDL particles, measured in concentration units. Represents the esterified cholesterol fraction within VLDL core lipids.

label: XL_VLDL_FC
description: Free cholesterol content in extra-large VLDL particles. Free cholesterol is found on the lipoprotein particle surface and plays a mediating role in metabolic disease pathways.

label: XL_VLDL_L
description: Total lipid content in extra-large VLDL particles, measured in concentration units.

label: XL_VLDL_P
description: Particle concentration/count of extra-large VLDL particles, typically measured in µmol/L or particles per liter.

label: XL_VLDL_PL
description: Phospholipid content in extra-large VLDL particles, measured in concentration units. Phospholipids comprise the structural shell of VLDL particles.

label: XL_VLDL_TG
description: Triglyceride content in extra-large VLDL (very low-density lipoprotein) particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XL-VLDL

label: XS_VLDL_C
description: Total cholesterol content in extra-small VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XS-VLDL

label: XS_VLDL_CE
description: Cholesteryl ester content in extra-small VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XS-VLDL

label: XS_VLDL_FC
description: Free cholesterol content in extra-small VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XS-VLDL

label: XS_VLDL_L
description: Total lipid concentration in extra-small VLDL particles, measured as absolute amount or relative percentage

label: XS_VLDL_PL
description: Phospholipid content in extra-small VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XS-VLDL

label: XS_VLDL_TG
description: Triglyceride content in extra-small VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XS-VLDL

label: XXL_VLDL_C
description: Total cholesterol content in extremely large VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XXL-VLDL

label: XXL_VLDL_CE
description: Cholesteryl ester content in extremely large VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XXL-VLDL

label: XXL_VLDL_FC
description: Free cholesterol content in extremely large VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XXL-VLDL

label: XXL_VLDL_L
description: Total lipid concentration in extremely large VLDL particles, measured as absolute amount or relative percentage

label: XXL_VLDL_P
description: Particle count or concentration of extremely large VLDL particles

label: XXL_VLDL_PL
description: Phospholipid content in extremely large VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XXL-VLDL

label: XXL_VLDL_TG
description: Triglyceride content in extremely large VLDL particles, measured as a percentage of total lipids in XXL-VLDL

label: non_HDL_C
description: Non-HDL cholesterol represents the total concentration of atherogenic lipoprotein cholesterol particles, calculated as total cholesterol minus HDL cholesterol. It includes LDL and other apoB-containing lipoproteins and is a key cardiovascular risk biomarker.

label: automorph_artery_fractal_dimension
description: Measures the fractal complexity specifically of retinal arteries, with values typically between 1-2 representing self-similar branching patterns in arterial network.

label: automorph_distance_tortuosity
description: Measures the distance-based tortuosity of the complete retinal vascular network, quantifying overall vessel path deviation from straight lines.

label: automorph_fractal_dimension
description: Measures the fractal complexity of the entire retinal vascular network, with values typically between 1-2 representing self-similar branching patterns and overall vascular complexity.

label: automorph_vein_average_width
description: Measures the mean caliber/diameter of retinal veins in pixels (microns), representing average venous vessel width throughout the retinal vascular network.

label: automorph_vein_fractal_dimension
description: Fractal dimension of retinal veins from image analysis, measuring the complexity and branching pattern of venous vasculature

label: automorph_vein_squared_curvature_tortuosity
description: Measures the curvature-based tortuosity (winding/twisting) of retinal veins, quantified as squared curvature. Higher values indicate more tortuous (curved) vein patterns.

label: automorph_vessel_density
description: Overall vessel density from retinal imaging, measuring the total proportion of blood vessel area (arteries and veins) relative to total retinal area

label: hr_bpm
description: Heart rate measured in beats per minute

label: intima_media_th_1_fit
description: Carotid artery intima-media thickness measurement from first ultrasound image, fitted/processed value. IMT is a validated surrogate marker of preclinical atherosclerosis and predictor of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.

label: intima_media_th_mm_1_intima_media_thickness
description: Carotid intima-media thickness from first measurement window in millimeters. Standard clinical measurement of arterial wall thickness indicating atherosclerotic burden.

label: lying_blood_pressure_pulse_rate
description: Heart rate in beats per minute measured in lying/supine position

label: p_axis
description: P wave axis in degrees (electrocardiogram measurement)

label: q_ms_aVL
description: Q wave duration in milliseconds in lead aVL from electrocardiogram (ECG). Q waves can indicate prior myocardial infarction or ventricular abnormalities.

label: qt_ms
description: QT interval measured in milliseconds. Represents the time interval on an electrocardiogram from the start of the Q wave to the end of the T wave, reflecting ventricular depolarization and repolarization duration.

label: r_ms_V3
description: R-wave amplitude or myocardial mass in lead V3 from electrocardiography, indicating ventricular electrical activity

label: r_mv_I
description: R-wave voltage (in millivolts) measured from electrocardiogram lead I. ECG parameter reflecting left ventricular electrical activity.

label: r_mv_V2

label: bt__albumin
description: Serum Albumin - the most abundant plasma protein synthesized by the liver; low levels indicate liver dysfunction, malnutrition, or disease, and is a marker of hepatic synthetic function.

label: liver_attenuation
description: Measures the attenuation coefficient of ultrasound or imaging waves passing through liver tissue; indicates liver density and composition, useful for detecting fatty liver disease and other structural abnormalities.

label: liver_elasticity
description: Measures the stiffness and elasticity of liver tissue using elastography techniques; a key biomarker for assessing liver fibrosis and disease progression, particularly in hepatitis and cirrhosis.

label: liver_sound_speed
description: Measures the speed of sound propagation through liver tissue; a physical property used in ultrasound elastography and tissue characterization to assess liver stiffness and fibrosis.

label: liver_viscosity
description: Measures the viscosity (thickness/resistance to flow) of liver tissue, typically obtained through ultrasound or imaging techniques to assess liver tissue properties and potential fibrosis or disease state.

label: bt__monocytes_abs
description: Absolute count of monocytes in blood (typically measured in thousands per microliter, K/µL). Represents total monocyte concentration in circulation.

label: bt__neutrophils_%
description: Percentage of neutrophils in white blood cell differential count. Neutrophils are the most abundant white blood cells and first-line immune responders to infection.

label: bt__neutrophils_abs
description: Absolute count of neutrophils in blood (typically measured in thousands per microliter, K/µL). Indicates total neutrophil concentration independent of other WBC populations.

label: bt__wbc
description: Total white blood cell (WBC) count (typically measured in thousands per microliter, K/µL). Represents total concentration of all leukocytes in circulation.

label: AlcoholicDrinks

description: Mean daily saturated fatty acids intake in grams

label: hips
description: Hip circumference measured in centimeters, an anthropometric measurement around the widest part of the hip/gluteal region

label: waist
description: Waist circumference measured in centimeters, an anthropometric measurement of abdominal adiposity

label: ahi
description: Apnea-Hypopnea Index; the number of apnea and hypopnea events per hour of sleep, a key diagnostic measure for sleep apnea severity

label: csr_percent
description: Cheyne-Stokes Respiration percentage - measures the proportion of sleep time exhibiting periodic breathing pattern characteristic of Cheyne-Stokes respiration

label: heart_rate_max_during_sleep
description: Maximum heart rate in beats per minute recorded during sleep

label: heart_rate_mean_during_sleep
description: Mean heart rate in beats per minute averaged across entire sleep period

label: hypoxic_burden
description: Cumulative measure of hypoxemia severity - quantifies the total oxygen desaturation burden during sleep, typically calculated as area under the curve of low oxygen saturation episodes

label: odi
description: Overall Oxygen Desaturation Index - measures the total number of oxygen desaturation events per hour across entire sleep study

label: rdi
description: Respiratory Disturbance Index - total number of apneic and hypopneic events per hour of sleep (similar to AHI)

label: rem_latency
description: Time elapsed from sleep onset to the first REM (Rapid Eye Movement) sleep period, measured in seconds. Important biomarker for depression, neurological conditions, and sleep architecture quality.

label: sleep_efficiency
description: Percentage of total time in bed that was spent in actual sleep. Calculated as (total sleep time / total time in bed) × 100. A key metric of sleep quality, with higher values indicating better sleep continuity.

label: total_light_sleep_time
description: Total duration in seconds of light sleep (Stage N1 and N2 non-REM sleep) during the night

label: total_sleep_time
description: Total duration of sleep during the entire recording period, measured in seconds. Core polysomnographic measure representing total sleep obtained and is used to assess sleep quantity and calculate other sleep indices.

label: bt__creatinine
description: Blood serum creatinine level, a waste product filtered by the kidneys. Measured in mg/dL or µmol/L. Used to assess kidney function and calculate glomerular filtration rate (GFR).

label: iglu_adrr
description: Average Daily Risk Range (ADRR) - a metric quantifying glucose variability and risk by measuring the range of glucose excursions and their frequency from continuous glucose monitoring

label: iglu_cv
description: Coefficient of Variation (CV) of glucose - a normalized measure of glucose variability expressed as a percentage, calculated as (standard deviation / mean glucose) × 100

label: iglu_cv_measures_mean
description: Coefficient of Variation adjusted for mean glucose - a measure of glucose variability normalized to account for the individual's mean glucose level

label: bt__mchc
description: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration - measures the average concentration of hemoglobin within red blood cells (g/dL). Calculated from hemoglobin divided by hematocrit.

label: bt__mcv
description: Mean Corpuscular Volume - measures the average size of red blood cells in femtoliters (fL). Used to classify types of anemia and assess red blood cell morphology.

label: sleep_hours
description: Average hours of sleep per 24-hour period, measuring sleep duration as a key health and lifestyle biomarker

label: vigorous_activity_minutes
description: Total minutes per week of vigorous-intensity physical activity, a cardiovascular fitness and lifestyle measure

label: walking_days_per_week
description: Number of days per week on which the participant engages in at least 10 minutes of walking activity

label: walking_minutes_day
description: Average daily duration of walking activity measured in minutes, reflecting regular aerobic exercise engagement

label: work_days_per_week
description: Number of days per week spent working, measuring occupational time commitment

label: work_hours_per_day
description: Total hours worked per week as a measure of occupational time commitment and work-related lifestyle factor

label: automorph_artery_fractal_dimension
description: Measures the fractal complexity specifically of retinal arteries, with values typically between 1-2 representing self-similar branching patterns in arterial network.

label: automorph_artery_squared_curvature_tortuosity
description: Squared curvature tortuosity of retinal arteries from automated image analysis, measuring the degree of vessel curvature and winding patterns

label: automorph_artery_vessel_density
description: Arterial vessel density from retinal imaging, measuring the proportion of arterial blood vessel area relative to total retinal area analyzed

label: automorph_fractal_dimension
description: Measures the fractal complexity of the entire retinal vascular network, with values typically between 1-2 representing self-similar branching patterns and overall vascular complexity.

label: automorph_vein_fractal_dimension
description: Fractal dimension of retinal veins from image analysis, measuring the complexity and branching pattern of venous vasculature

label: automorph_vein_vessel_density
description: A quantitative measure of vein vessel density derived from automated morphological analysis. This biomarker represents the proportion or concentration of vascular tissue within a defined region, typically expressed as a ratio or percentage. Vessel density is an important cardiovascular biomarker indicating vascularization level, which relates to tissue perfusion, angiogenesis, and overall vascular health.

label: automorph_vessel_density
description: Overall vessel density from retinal imaging, measuring the total proportion of blood vessel area (arteries and veins) relative to total retinal area

label: hr_bpm
description: Heart rate measured in beats per minute

label: intima_media_th_1_fit
description: Carotid artery intima-media thickness measurement from first ultrasound image, fitted/processed value. IMT is a validated surrogate marker of preclinical atherosclerosis and predictor of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.

label: intima_media_th_2_fit
description: Carotid artery intima-media thickness measurement from second ultrasound image, fitted/processed value. IMT indicator of atherosclerosis.

label: p_mv_I
description: P wave amplitude in lead I measured in millivolts. Represents the positive deflection of the P wave in this limb lead, reflecting atrial depolarization.

label: q_ms_aVL
description: Q wave duration in milliseconds in lead aVL from electrocardiogram (ECG). Q waves can indicate prior myocardial infarction or ventricular abnormalities.

label: qt_ms
description: QT interval measured in milliseconds. Represents the time interval on an electrocardiogram from the start of the Q wave to the end of the T wave, reflecting ventricular depolarization and repolarization duration.

label: r_ms_V2
description: R-wave amplitude or myocardial mass in lead V2 from electrocardiography, indicating ventricular electrical activity

label: r_mv_V3
description: R wave amplitude in lead V3 (electrocardiogram measurement)

label: r_mv_V4
description: R-wave voltage (in millivolts) from electrocardiogram precordial lead V4. ECG parameter reflecting left ventricular electrical activity.

label: r_mv_V5
description: Cardiac electrical potential (voltage) measured in lead V5 from electrocardiogram (ECG), representing left anterior chest lead

label: r_mv_V6
description: R wave amplitude in the V6 lead (lateral precordial lead) measured in millivolts. Represents the positive deflection of the R wave in this chest lead, reflecting left ventricular electrical activity.

label: r_r_ms
description: R-R interval in milliseconds from electrocardiogram (ECG), representing the time between consecutive R waves. This interval reflects the cardiac cycle duration and heart rate variability.

label: s_mv_I
description: S-wave myocardial velocity in standard lead I from electrocardiography, measuring ventricular depolarization

label: s_mv_V2
description: S wave amplitude in ECG lead V2 (millimeters or standardized units); represents ventricular depolarization vector in the right precordial region

label: s_mv_V3
description: S-wave myocardial velocity in lead V3 from electrocardiography, measuring ventricular depolarization activity

label: sitting_blood_pressure_pulse_rate
description: Heart rate (pulse) in beats per minute measured while patient is in sitting position

label: sitting_blood_pressure_systolic
description: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg measured while patient is in sitting position

label: standing_one_min_blood_pressure_pulse_rate
description: Heart rate in beats per minute measured after standing for 1 minute

label: ahi
description: Apnea-Hypopnea Index; the number of apnea and hypopnea events per hour of sleep, a key diagnostic measure for sleep apnea severity

label: hypoxic_burden
description: Cumulative measure of hypoxemia severity - quantifies the total oxygen desaturation burden during sleep, typically calculated as area under the curve of low oxygen saturation episodes

label: percent_of_rem_sleep_time
description: Percentage of total sleep time spent in REM sleep - proportion of sleep dedicated to rapid eye movement sleep stage

label: rdi
description: Respiratory Disturbance Index - total number of apneic and hypopneic events per hour of sleep (similar to AHI)

label: saturation_min_value
description: Minimum oxygen saturation level (SpO2) recorded during sleep, measured as a percentage. Indicates the lowest point of blood oxygen desaturation during the sleep study.

label: sleep_efficiency
description: Percentage of total time in bed that was spent in actual sleep. Calculated as (total sleep time / total time in bed) × 100. A key metric of sleep quality, with higher values indicating better sleep continuity.

label: hips
description: Hip circumference measured in centimeters, an anthropometric measurement around the widest part of the hip/gluteal region

label: waist
description: Waist circumference measured in centimeters, an anthropometric measurement of abdominal adiposity

label: bt__monocytes_abs
description: Absolute count of monocytes in blood (typically measured in thousands per microliter, K/µL). Represents total monocyte concentration in circulation.
